stops.coordinate_note: NOAA Coast Pilot 4, chapter 10, paragraph 346, revised November 1, 2026, provides this rounded reference. This is not a berth or anchorage.

trip_notes: Flexible example: stage in South Florida; cross and complete clearance; allow two local days; plan a return crossing; keep two additional weather days uncommitted. Local and weather days are notes, not scheduled movement legs. Confirm current documents, customs arrangements, overnight space, fuel supply, provisions, communications, actual route and shore-contact expectations. Brown’s Marina is the candidate Bimini destination reference, not a confirmed berth, fueling arrangement or reviewed approach. Its published coordinates have no stated datum or revision. Contact the marina and review current charts and conditions for the harbor approach. The Port Everglades reference is the published PE buoy, not a Florida berth; add and review staging movements separately. Member review records planning review only, never independent navigation verification. Example route distance — review for your trip. Each movement starts with an owner-supplied 50.3 NM planning estimate; the return follows the same example path in reverse. Measurement method, chart source and date are unspecified. Review or replace each leg before Float Plan creation.
